messages:
ivy: Build failed on the nightly docs deploy. Link resolver error: "MissingFragmentError: unable to resolve fragment '' in page /guides/payments".

ivy: Quick grep shows the page has a heading that is only an HTML comment: `## <!-- placeholder for payments content -->`. That produces an empty heading text and an empty slug.

marco: Ohh, that's sneaky. Someone left a placeholder heading and the MDX parser treats it as a heading node with no text. Slugifier emits an empty fragment id.

tina: Easy fix: remove the empty heading or replace with a real title, or add `slug:` in the frontmatter. Which PR touched that file?

ivy: PR #4010 added the page skeleton. Pushing a revert-ish tiny patch to replace the comment-only heading with `## Payments (coming soon)` and add `slug: guides-payments` in frontmatter to be safe.

docs-bot: @ivy opened PR #4015 — "docs: replace placeholder comment-heading with real heading + add slug" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4015

ci-bot: docs CI started for PR #4015 (docusaurus build + linkcheck)

ci-bot: docusaurus build ✅ for PR #4015 — linkcheck passed, no missing fragments

marco: Great. We should add a CONTRIBUTING note: avoid comment-only headings and prefer explicit frontmatter slugs for skeleton pages. Also a tiny lint in CI to detect headings where all text is an HTML comment.

tina: Filed issue #152 to add a docs linter that flags comment-only headings and suggests adding a slug or real text.

ivy: Merged and deployed to staging — anchors and deep links working now. Closing thread, thanks everyone :rocket:
